As the Pacific Northwest’s leading packer and co-packer for nearly a century, Portland Bottling Company delivers end-to-end services, from filling, packing and cartoning to multi-packing and repacking to 3PL and on/off-site warehousing.

When it comes to ready-to-drink beverages, Portland Bottling Company is RTD: ready to deliver. We bring customers proactive solutions and partnership. We offer 24/7, end-to-end solutions with state-of-the-art equipment, in-line monitoring, in-house QA, and automated technologies for next-level quality, reliability, efficiency and yield. Most importantly, our people don’t sit back; we proactively communicate and enable solutions through every stage of the production process.
Today, Portland Bottling Company operates out of multiple locations including our brand-new, state-of-the-art facilities, strategically located just beyond the city in Clackamas, within miles of the Port of Portland and the interstate, providing convenient distribution channels for our customers throughout the Western United States and Canada.
Our Clackamas operations launched in 2020, focusing our expertise on making a wide variety of ready-to-drink (RTD) beverage products, in aluminum cans. As a leading West Coast co-packer, Portland Bottling produces beverages ranging from juices and energy drinks to coffee, teas, and carbonated sodas.
